definitions.accruedUSD: fees + incentives earned by the stake since allocation (claimed + unclaimed), current prices; feesUSD/incentivesUSD are the unclaimed parts, claimedUSD what was already claimed
definitions.alerts: gauge_no_earnings_24h (allocated gauge < $1/day over 24h), rate_drop / fees_rate_drop (24h < 50% of 7d), negative_delta (cumulative fell: claims not scanned?)
definitions.feesOnly: same figures counting trading fees only (no incentive programs)
definitions.history: points >= 12 h apart (<= 10.5 d; plus the first of each epoch): per-gauge cumulative token amounts keyed chainId:gauge, claimed + unclaimed, with when the gauge was first seen and whether it was allocated then (a gauge missing from a window's older point counts from zero only if first seen later while allocated); only chains whose claims were scanned, only gauges read in full (failed reads listed in unread); complete when that run's read was
definitions.positionAprPct: usdPerDay*365 / (staked AERO * AERO price) * 100; unmeasured chains count as earning 0
definitions.projectedStakerApyPct: usdPerDay*365 * stakersShareBps/10000 / stakedIaeroUSD * 100; stakedIaeroUSD is the realized apyPct denominator (staked iAERO at epoch start * iAERO price)
definitions.readComplete: every chain read (claims scanned, gauge list and every gauge read) and every earned token priced
definitions.stale: true when this block could not be rebuilt and the previous one was kept as is
definitions.trailing: 24h / 7d rates from the change in per-gauge cumulative earnings since the complete history point closest to 24 h (20-36 h old) / 7 d (6-8 d old) before this run, valued at current prices; null until such a point exists or when the two points share no fully measured chain; partial when a chain or gauge is left out
definitions.usdPerDay: sum over gauges of accruedUSD / days since allocation on that chain
